--- pipe_aggregate_minimal.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: -1,
            Expr:   &ast.CountStarExpr{
              Count:  24,
              Rparen: 31,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*)
